The <b>Hunter Crest</b> is the starting [[Crests|Crest]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It starts with no special properties. When evolved, it gains the ability to build <b>focus</b> by striking enemies, which increases [[Needle]] damage. 
== Attacks ==
* Neutral Slashes: Hornet strikes in a medium sized arc.
* Down-slash: Hornet does a long dash strike diagonally downwards.
* [[Swift Step|Run-slash]]: Hornet strikes with the point of her needle and keeps running on a miss. On a hit, Hornet is launched into the air, similarly to a Down-slash.
* [[Needle Strike]]: Hornet executes two great slashes. Unlike all other multi-hit attacks, both slashes can generate a strand of silk. Inflicts [[Heavy Damage]].

== Mechanics ==
After being evolved, Hornet will build focus upon hitting enemies. Needle damage is multiplied by 1.3x once focus is fully built up after 6 hits. Partially built focus does not grant part of the damage bonus. Focus resets to zero if Hornet takes damage, becomes infested by [[Muckmaggot]]s, or sits on a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]]. Focus is represented on the HUD with a bar curving around the left side of the Crest icon that fills from the middle.

With the second evolution, another tier of focus is added, with the multiplier increasing to 1.5x upon reaching it with 6 more hits, or 12 hits in total. The focus meter on the HUD Crest is extended, with a gap to separate the tiers.

* Focus does not increase {{CrestSlot|Skill|1}} damage. 
* Both [[Challenge]] and [[Clawline]] build 1 hit of Focus on hit.

== Usefulness ==
Hunter Crest offers a balance of [[Tool]] slots, attack range and attack speed.
* Down-slash can be used to dodge attacks and close distance on enemies.
* Run-slash has generous range and area coverage.
* Needle Strike can deal high damage and generate more [[Silk]] than normal.
* When fully upgraded and at max Focus, Hunter Crest has the highest sustained Needle DPS of any Crest.
* Weaknesses:
** Hunter Crest's Down-slash being at a diagonal angle can make it difficult to bounce off objects and enemies.
** [[Memory Locket|Memory Lockets]] used on the Hunter Crest do not count towards [[Eva]]'s Tool slot count for her upgrades.

== Synergies ==
Due to the balance of available Tool slots and no significant strengths or weaknesses, the Hunter Crest has several options for builds:

* The [[Delver's Drill]] allows Hornet to attack directly downwards from a distance, offsetting the down-slash being unable to.
* [[Flintslate]]'s damage increase only stacks additively with focus; [[Flea Brew]] may therefore be a better alternative for burst Needle damage, and can also be used to build focus faster.
* [[Longclaw]] increases Hunter Crest's attack range for more consistent safety and focus.
* [[Pin Badge]] is reliable for generating both Silk and focus quickly, and also allowing longer range needle attacks to keep a safer range from enemies.
* [[Magnetite Dice]], [[Cross Stitch]] and [[Warding Bell]] can all prevent damage, and therefore the loss of focus.
* While focus is being consistently maintained, Binding is unnecessary and Skills do not benefit like the Needle does, leading to an abundance of Silk for [[Wispfire Lantern]] and [[Silkspeed Anklets]] to passively use.

== How to Acquire ==
This crest is available from the start, as Hornet has it equipped at base. 

It can be evolved by speaking with [[Eva]] in [[Weavenest Atla]], which is found behind a door opened with the [[Needolin]] at the easternmost edge of [[Moss Grotto]]. After unlocking 27 total slots on all Crests besides the Hunter Crest and speaking to Eva again will allow Hornet to fully evolve the Crest.{{Gallery

== Trivia ==
* The Hunter Crest's attacks are based on those Hornet used [[Hornet Protector|as a boss in Hollow Knight]].
* Hornet has the Hunter Crest forcefully equipped to her after certain cutscenes: After it is upgraded, when reclaiming her belongings after getting [[Cloakless Crest|captured]], and after entering [[Act 3]].
* Getting silk drained by a [[Clawmaiden]] and getting captured by a [[Barnak]] do not reset the focus meter.
* [[Winged Lifeseed]]s and {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Summoned Saviour]] do not grant focus when struck.
* After reaching the first tier of the evolved Hunter Crest's damage bonus, hitting enemies with the [[Needle]] makes a visual effect resembling [[Sylphsong]]'s visual effect appear. Once Hornet reaches the second tier of the damage bonus, this visual effect is strengthened.
